decisions.decision: Model B: named port leases. Humans always use the numeric port.
decisions.rationale: Phone/Tailscale/bookmarks and firewall rules are port contracts. A localhost proxy does not fix that.

decisions.decision: v1 = stable leases + dashboard + host firewall sync; observed listeners in the same board. Amended by D13 to all desktop OSes.
decisions.rationale: Engram timed out on Tailscale because the firewall rule was still on 5173 after the app moved to 5193.

decisions.decision: Repo folder localberth. CLI is localberth, not the crowded global berth binary.
decisions.rationale: Folder matches the public name. cargo/@whenlabs/berth already own `berth` on PATH.

decisions.decision: Public name LocalBerth; domain localberth.com is the FilePress explainer (what + how-to), not the running app. Pairing with localhost (machine vs slip), not a replacement for localhost URLs.
decisions.rationale: localhost + LocalBerth read as a pair. Domain is available. Avoids berth CLI/search collisions. Site vs daemon must stay distinct.
alternatives_considered: Host the dashboard at the domain

decisions.decision: Stack matches Engram: SvelteKit 5 + Tailwind + pnpm + TypeScript ESM + adapter-node + SQLite (better-sqlite3).
decisions.rationale: Same machine, same muscle memory, Node needed for listen table and firewall.

decisions.decision: Live state in ~/.localberth/. Repo data/ is fixtures only.
decisions.rationale: Leases must survive moving or deleting the git checkout.

decisions.decision: License Apache-2.0.
decisions.rationale: Match Engram / ForgeTrail.

decisions.decision: Dashboard self-lease localberth → TCP 54321.
decisions.rationale: High, easy to type, not Postgres 5432.

decisions.decision: Rename repo folder berth → localberth.
decisions.rationale: Match public name and domain; /berth was only a short sibling path.

decisions.decision: localberth.com is a FilePress site (in-repo site/). Explains what LocalBerth is and how to use it. Hosted static (Cloudflare Pages, root directory site).
decisions.rationale: Same FilePress pattern as getfilepress.com. Domain must not be mistaken for the local dashboard.

decisions.decision: The app ships as a published unscoped npm package named localberth (bin localberth). It runs locally after install. Name reserved as localberth@0.0.0 on 2026-08-18.
decisions.rationale: Operator install path is npm/pnpm, not cloning this repo. Avoid the crowded berth bin.

decisions.decision: Publish localberth@0.0.0 as a name stake (placeholder bin, files whitelist). Human publishes; agent does not. Omit homepage, repository, and bugs until localberth.com is live and the GitHub repo is public.
decisions.rationale: Reserve the unscoped npm name before the spine exists. Dead or auth-walled links on the public npm page are worse than no links.

decisions.decision: v1 is cross-platform. CLI, scan, dashboard, and firewall sync on Windows (netsh), macOS (pf), and Linux (ufw or firewalld). Kickoff was Windows; the product is not Windows-only.
decisions.rationale: Same stale-port / firewall miss happens on any OS that filters inbound LAN or Tailscale.

decisions.decision: Root README is the public npm page: product one-liner + install tease. Process, phase, and sibling notes stay in docs/ and .forgetrail/. Amended by D17.
decisions.rationale: 0.0.0 README overshared Phase 1 internals on npmjs.com.
alternatives_considered: Keep operator status on the package page

decisions.decision: localberth serve is a built-in Node dashboard (no Vite required) so a global npm install can open :54321. pnpm dev stays the SvelteKit board for checkout work.
decisions.rationale: Vite is a devDependency; the installed CLI must still show the harbor board.

decisions.decision: Firewall hardening: skip inbound for loopback binds; Windows/Linux only create or delete rules named LocalBerth <name> <port> (ufw by comment, firewalld rich rules). macOS writes a pf anchor file and loads anchor localberth.
decisions.rationale: A 127.0.0.1 dashboard must not punch a WAN hole. Never delete an operator rule that happens to share a port.
alternatives_considered: Always open the port on all interfaces

decisions.decision: Phase 3 README is a public usage page (install, commands, serve, firewall/loopback, Vite helper, checkout). Still no ForgeTrail, siblings, or machine paths. Amends D14 “short tease”.
decisions.rationale: The spine exists; npm and git checkout readers need the real CLI. Process notes stay in CONTEXT_PROMPT.md / docs / .forgetrail/.

decisions.decision: claim --or-next: if --port is leased or listening, assign the next free pool port. Default still allows claiming a listening port (name what is there). Pool allocation always skips listening ports.
decisions.rationale: Prefer-5193-else-free is a real start path; attaching a name to an already-running app is the hero path and must not require a free port.

decisions.decision: Public explainer metaphor: LocalBerth is local DNS for ports. Names resolve to TCP numbers on this machine. Still not real DNS, not a reverse proxy, and not *.localhost URLs (D1 / D4).
decisions.rationale: DNS is the familiar name→number lookup. The gap people feel is ports, not hostnames.
alternatives_considered: Port name service without the DNS analogy

decisions.decision: Public copy follows aiBreze (core + landing). Overlay in docs/aibreze-overlay.md. Protected: localhost/slip pairing and Local DNS for ports. Public pages say dashboard, not harbor board.
decisions.rationale: Same house voice as other Catalyst Forge pages. npm README is a brochure; checkout notes stay last.
alternatives_considered: Landing voice on the flag list

decisions.decision: claim defaults to bind 127.0.0.1. --lan binds 0.0.0.0 and syncs inbound firewall. --bind ADDR still works. --lan and --bind together is an error. Ephemeral is no longer a special-case bind default.
decisions.rationale: Opening past loopback should be intentional, especially once agents invoke claim. Phone/LAN access stays one flag. Same issue raised on DictaWhisper.

decisions.decision: better-sqlite3 ^13 (N-API prebuilds in the npm tarball). Do not stay on 12.x for the published CLI.
decisions.rationale: npm 12 (Node 24) blocks dependency install scripts. better-sqlite3 12 never downloads a .node on npm i -g localberth. Global installs cannot use package.json allowScripts. 13 ships prebuilds/win32-x64.node and has no install script.
alternatives_considered: Switch the store to node:sqlite or JSON

gotchas.gotcha: FilePress adapter-static build fails with no posts: Routes marked prerenderable but not prerendered: /posts/[slug]
gotchas.fix: Keep at least one posts/*.md in site/.

gotchas.gotcha: npm i -g localberth@0.2.0 on Node 24 / npm 12: Could not locate the bindings file (better-sqlite3). ignore-scripts is false; allowScripts default is off, so 12.x never runs prebuild-install.
gotchas.fix: Depend on better-sqlite3 ^13. Workaround on 0.2.0: npm i -g localberth --allow-scripts=better-sqlite3.
